definition: AI systems, such as chatbots and voice assistants, designed to engage in natural, multi-turn dialogue with users.
details: Conversational AI encompasses both rule-based and modern LLM-powered dialogue systems, with the latter offering dramatically more flexible and open-ended interaction compared to earlier scripted chatbot approaches.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Conversational AI.
